title: Split screen, second look (DPC Split Screen 0.1.0-dev2, DPC 0.9.177-dev38)
intro: About 3 minutes. Same setup as before: start co-op, player 2 on a controller. If anything goes black, freezes or looks broken, press End and tell Claude; the split stops itself after one error now.

probes.split: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and (S.active and 'ON' or 'off') or 'not loaded'
probes.outid: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and tostring(S.ro_after or '') or ''
probes.errs: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and S.st.errors or 0
probes.lasterr: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and tostring(S.st.last_error or '') or ''
probes.halted: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and tostring(S.halted or '') or ''
probes.turns: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and S.st.turns or 0
probes.frames: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; return S and S.st.frames or 0
probes.camblk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.views_cam_n or 0

steps.text: SPLIT SCREEN 2. Start co-op (Ctrl+F6, player 2 holds L3 + R3). Press End once the screen has split.
1/3 Is player 2's half (right) showing the world now, or still black? Then player 2 turns his right stick: only HIS half should turn, not yours. Press End.
2/3 Player 2 walks around with the left stick: does he walk where his view faces? You walk and turn the mouse: does only your half turn? Press End.
3/3 End co-op (Ctrl+F6). One normal view again? Press End, then tell Claude what you saw.
